name: tuned 2560x1440 @ 120fps (120 Hz panel)
description: Same engine as twixt-1440p.json but 120 fps out: 165 fps median, 159 worst, 1.33x. Only use this with the monitor set to 120 Hz, where it is a perfect 1:1 cadence. At 180 Hz it is 1.5 refreshes per frame, which alternates 1-2-1-2 and beats visibly -- worse than 90 fps despite the higher number.
